_about: How the voice tool says sound-words it doesn't know. Without this list it spells some out letter by letter ("Hm" as H-M, "Shh" as S-H-H). Each entry: a pattern for one word (any capitals, any number of repeated letters) and the sounds to say instead. A word joined with hyphens (Hoo-hoo-hoo) is said piece by piece, with a small break between pieces. Changing a sound makes the lines that use it again.
